title: Veric
tagline: A Decentralized Credential Oracle for Web 3.0, which address the gap of asset verification from Web 2 to Web 3, resolve secure asset verification across chains, and build on top of W3C standard compliance
description: An oracle protocol built on Cryptographic Verifiable Credential that enables everyone and every asset to have a set of digital credentials for composability and interoperability. It allows everyone and every asset to create, register, verify and revoke a set of digital credentials from Web 2 to utilize in Web 3
how_its_made: This project uses solidity for smart contracts deployed on multi chains (Polygon / Harmony), VueJS for frontend to enable users to manage their DID, VC (verifiable credential) and VP (verification proof) in website, browser plugin and mobile app, and we code in Go for backend to handle the different use cases (KYC / payment gateway), we also leverage Mina protocol to build the zkApp and the Graph to index the DeFi and NFT data.
